items.title: LLMs Knowingly Hide Their Mistakes
items.content_text: TL;DR: We prefill models with synthetic mistakes and then send a follow-up message. Models fail to disclose the mistake in 67% of cases. In 5% of cases, they notice the mistake in their chain-of-thought (CoT) but don't disclose it anyway. This is deception by omission. This means models cannot be relied upon to self-report their mistakes.
